content_html: I’m curious to see what this would look like if you were using an O/R mapper like NHibernate. Would you still use a CategoryData object? Or would you say use Find, Get, Save, etc. methods in your BO? Or would you access the O/R mapper directly from your code behind to get the objects you needed?

NHibernate would then by my data access goo, so I’d decide then. I might just make a Repository object ask NHibernate for the object. I would not want the Find, Get, Save methods on my business object itself. I’d want to give that responsibility to a Repository object. I would never hit a data access technology directly from code-behind. Code-behind is part of the view, and that would even violate MVC. I’d call my repository from my controller and push data to my view.
